title: The name of the Operations dashboard (admins see how the workspace is used, what fails and what it costs): its page title, breadcrumb and section nav's accessible name.
crumbs.chat: Breadcrumb for a chat's admin transcript, while the chat has no title.
groups.dashboard: Heading of the section nav's first group: the dashboard's pages of numbers.
groups.oversight: Heading of the section nav's second group: who looked at what, which access socios have, and the dashboard's settings.
sections.overview.label: Each sections.*.label: a page of the Operations dashboard, in its section nav, page title and breadcrumb. Short. "Socio" is a product noun (an AI agent), "Space" one too (a shared area of pages).
sections.activity.label: A page of the Operations dashboard: who works with which socios (AI agents), how often and through which channels.
sections.value.label: A page of the Operations dashboard: which work gets finished, which is left, and what people come back for.
sections.themes.label: A page of the Operations dashboard: what people come to socios for (intents and recurring topics).
sections.knowledge.label: A page of the Operations dashboard: Spaces, pages, datasets and storage, and how they are used.
sections.reliability.label: A page of the Operations dashboard: what fails and why (turns, tools, retries).
sections.capabilities.label: A page of the Operations dashboard: what socios can do and what they are asked for.
sections.health.label: A page of the Operations dashboard: the state of models, queues, schedules, backups and the server's resources.
sections.cost.label: A page of the Operations dashboard: what socios' answers cost, and the prices behind them.
sections.access-log.label: The log of admins opening people's activity, chats and traces.
sections.socio-access.label: Which socios (AI agents) may act in which apps on behalf of which people.
sections.settings.label: A page of the Operations dashboard with the dashboard's own settings (time zone, sessions, retention, price sync, labeling); not the app's Settings.
load-failed: Shown when a page's numbers didn't load and the server gave no reason.
